props.heading: Ask us anything.
props.text: Find quick answers to your questions about our services, billing, or account setup. If you cannot find what you need, our team is always ready to assist you.

questions.question: How long does delivery take?
questions.answer: Complimentary express delivery arrives in 2–3 business days worldwide. Each parcel ships from the nearest atelier — Paris, New York, or Seoul — so nothing crosses more borders than it has to.

questions.question: Where is my order right now?
questions.answer: Open your account and choose Orders: every parcel has its live tracking link there. You also receive it by email the moment your order leaves the atelier.

questions.question: Do you ship internationally?
questions.answer: Yes, to more than 60 countries. Duties and taxes are shown at checkout, so there is nothing more to pay on delivery.

questions.question: How is my order packaged?
questions.answer: In recycled card and paper only, without plastic fillers. Refills travel in their own sleeve, ready to slip into your case.

questions.question: How do I create an account?
questions.answer: Choose Login in the top navigation and switch to Create Account. You only need a name, an email and a password — we never ask for anything we do not use.

questions.question: I have forgotten my password.
questions.answer: Choose Login, then Forgot your password, and enter your email. We send you a link to choose a new one; it stays valid for 24 hours.

questions.question: Can I change my saved address?
questions.answer: Yes. In your account, open Addresses to edit, add or remove one, and choose which is your default for checkout.

questions.question: How do I close my account?
questions.answer: Write to us from the contact page with the email of your account. We close it within two working days and confirm once your data is deleted.

topics.title: Returns & Exchanges
topics.text: Sixty days, collected from your door

questions.question: What is your return policy?
questions.answer: You have sixty days to return any unopened product, and thirty days for opened skincare that did not suit you. Returns are always free.

questions.question: How do I start a return?
questions.answer: Open the order in your account and choose Return items, or write to us. We book a courier to collect the parcel from your door.

questions.question: Can I exchange a shade or size?
questions.answer: Yes. Choose Exchange instead of Return and pick the new shade or size; we send it as soon as the courier has collected the first one.

questions.question: When will I get my refund?
questions.answer: Within five working days after the parcel reaches us, back to the card or account you paid with.

questions.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
questions.answer: All major cards, Shop Pay, Apple Pay, Google Pay and PayPal. The methods available in your country are shown at checkout.

questions.question: Is my payment information secure?
questions.answer: Yes. Payments are handled by Shopify on encrypted connections, and we never see or store your full card number.

questions.question: Can I get an invoice for my order?
questions.answer: Your order confirmation email is your receipt. For a company invoice with your tax number, write to us with the order number.

questions.question: How do I use a promo code?
questions.answer: Enter it in the Discount code field at checkout. One code applies per order, and the saving shows before you pay.

questions.question: Are your formulas suitable for sensitive skin?
questions.answer: Every formula is dermatologist-tested, fragrance-optional and free of drying alcohols. The Frost and Pearl lines are built specifically for reactive skin.

questions.question: Is the gold in your formulas real?
questions.answer: Yes. Our gold-infused formulas use pure 24-carat gold leaf, suspended in small amounts for radiance; it is safe on skin and never coloured.

questions.question: How long until I see results?
questions.answer: Most clients see a difference in texture within two weeks, and in tone and firmness after six to eight weeks of daily use.

questions.question: Do you test on animals?
questions.answer: Never. OroSkin is cruelty-free and vegan, and none of our ingredient suppliers test on animals either.

contact.heading: Still unanswered?
contact.text: A real person replies within one working day — usually within the hour, Paris time.
